note: Hand-written at realistic length. A club digest with nine unrelated sections, four of them carrying real dates and one a discount code. The real version of this produced four obligations in production — a yoga class twice, a discount code, and a statement reminder — while a 1,600-character stand-in passed the suite easily. Scrubbing compresses long HTML mail by roughly a third, so captured newsletters understate the difficulty. Nothing here is addressed to this reader.

messages.body:
THE QUARTERLY
Your bi-monthly club update

Welcome to The Quarterly. Below you will find everything happening across the club over the coming weeks.


TENNIS COURT RESURFACING

Beginning 29 August all outdoor tennis courts will be temporarily closed for resurfacing and are expected to reopen on 7 September. While the work is underway, members are welcome at our sister site, where courts are included with your membership. We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the playing surface.


LAST WEEKS OF SUMMER CAMP

Make the most of the final weeks of summer with camps for every interest, from sports and cooking to robotics, ninja challenges and outdoor adventures. Need a solution to a last-minute schedule change? Flexible single-day and weeklong options are available. Enrol through the member portal.


UNLIMITED FAMILY FUN

We are introducing a new membership add-on giving unlimited access to family entertainment centres at two locations. With laser tag, bowling, arcade games and escape rooms, there are endless ways to play. Visit the front desk to get started.


INDOOR FOOTBALL: AUTUMN ADULT LEAGUES

Now the season has ended, it is time to go from watching to playing. Autumn indoor leagues kick off in mid-September and there is still time to register as a team or as an individual. Men's, women's and mixed leagues are available at all skill levels. Register through the member portal.


AUGUST MEMBER PERK

Elevate your everyday with luxury organic cotton sheets, towels and bedding from one of our retail partners. Enjoy an exclusive 15% member-only discount plus a complimentary gift with purchase. Use code MEM15 at checkout. Offer valid 1-31 August 2026. Explore all perks in the member portal.


GROUP SWIM LESSONS

Enrolment opens 20 August. Build confidence in the water with our eight-week group swim lessons for all ages, from six months to adults. Register through the member portal or reach out to the aquatics team with questions.


EXECUTIVE LOCKER ROOM AVAILABILITY

Upgrade your club routine with a personal locker, daily robe and slipper service, a eucalyptus steam room and sauna, premium amenities, a beverage lounge and more. Stop by member services to reserve.


AUTUMN AFTERSCHOOL TENNIS

Afterschool tennis returns this autumn with classes for ages 6 to 18. Children can hit the courts, sharpen their game and have fun after school. Registration is now open in the member portal.


SUMMER RESET YOGA

Enrolment opens 20 August. Reset your body and mind with a 90-minute Yin Yoga experience featuring long-held stretches, self-massage and a calming sound bath. Sessions are offered 29 and 30 August. Sign up at the front desk or email the studio team.


We will see you around the club.


For more information on any of the above, hit reply to connect with our regional director.


MANAGE YOUR MEMBERSHIP

BILLING REMINDER
- Monthly statements are available on the 1st of each month.
- Payment is due by the last day of the month.
- AutoPay: payments are processed on the 16th of each month. If you are enrolled, no action is needed.
- View your statement, update your payment method or make a payment in the member app under Profile, then Billing, then Payment Method.
- Visit the FAQs to learn more.


*Summer Camp: to receive membership pricing, children must be on a membership. Camp fees vary by camp type and location. Lunch is included in Little Explorers and Multi-Sport camps. Camps are available at select clubs, with offerings and ages varying by location. The sibling discount applies only to the second and any additional children. Other restrictions may apply. The club reserves the right to amend, suspend or change the offer at any time without notice.

*Unlimited Family Fun: the all-access add-on includes unlimited access to select attractions and arcade games at each location. Members must check in at the front desk each visit. Attractions cannot be reserved in advance and access is non-transferable. Available during all operating hours from May through September. From October through April, access is available during weekday operating hours, with weekend access limited to before noon and after 6pm. Excludes parties, private events, group bookings, ticketed events and food or retail purchases.

*Member Perk: offer valid 1-31 August 2026. Use code MEM15 at checkout to receive the offer. Qualifying orders include a complimentary gift with purchase while supplies last. Terms and exclusions apply.
